content.text:
The report lists these failures: the momentum-in-flow-rate × wage momentum interaction had ~0 correlation in both regimes; thin coverage; a non-whitelisted transformation (invalid); hours momentum gated to high-T gave tiny correlation; the spread was slightly negative; regime-gated features were highly persistent (0.45-0.50 autocorrelation).

The proposed expression is regime-gated (low-T), so it likely inherits the high persistence problem. It also uses flow-rate momentum, which was already tried in the interaction, though this is not the identical construction. The gating is not a low-persistence construction. It also uses "regime" and "csrank" and "chg", whose whitelist status is unknown. It does not explicitly address any of the failures: it does not address persistence, coverage, or the whitelist issue.

The hypothesis is a plain flow-rate momentum signal in the low-T regime, which was already shown to have about zero correlation in the low-T state (as part of the interaction). It doesn't avoid the failures.

{"avoids_failure": false}
